observations: Photo 0: A full-size electronic keyboard/synth is wrapped in plastic; keys are visible (black and white).
Photo 0: There is a control panel with many buttons/knobs and a small display area, but the text is not clearly readable.
Photo 1: Similar view; still wrapped in plastic, with the same keyboard layout and controls visible.
No clear brand/model name is readable on the front from these photos.

identity.kind: electronic keyboard (full-size, with built-in speakers/control panel)

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Brand/model and audio performance (“super sounds”) are not verifiable from the photos; the keyboard is wrapped and no sound test is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model may not be “Quality London” (identity mismatch affects correct pricing and compatibility).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (usually on the front panel, back panel, or underside) showing exact text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used electronic keyboard (worst-case: unknown brand/model).

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (keys, speakers, power, and buttons may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on and a full range key test (play low to high keys) plus a quick demo of sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully working / untested until proven.

risks.risk: Physical condition may be worse than it looks (plastic wrap can hide cracks, bent keys, or missing parts).
risks.proof: Photos of the keyboard after removing plastic: corners/edges, keybed surface, and any visible damage; plus close-ups of the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cosmetic/hidden damage.

risks.risk: Accessories/cables may be missing (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power adapter, pedal, cables, stand if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the keyboard is included (no accessories).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model label (front/back/underside) so the exact model can be identified.
Video: power-on + sound demo + key test across the full keyboard range.
Photos after removing the plastic wrap showing any cracks/dents and the condition of the keybed and control panel.
Photo of included items (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables/stand/manual).
response.reason: The photos show a wrapped full-size electronic keyboard, but the brand/model and working condition (“super sounds”) cannot be verified remotely. Without identity and a functionality proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
